newsitem.title: USA: Terra Nova hires Wedlake as financial chief.
newsitem.headline: Terra Nova hires Wedlake as financial chief.

text.p: Terra Nova (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd said Monday it hired William Wedlake as senior vice president and chief financial officer.
Wedlake joins Terra Nova from Guardian Royal Exchange where he was regional finance director for the U.K. and Ireland.
Terra Nova said Wedlake's responsibilities would encompass group finance and accounting, investor relations, information technology and contract administration.

Wedlake will be based in London, where the centralized administration facilities for the Terra Nova Group operations are located. He will report jointly to the chairman of Terra Nova and the managing director of Terra Nova Insurance Co.
"This appointment completes our corporate management team and strengthens our strategic planning capability," the company's statement said.
